title: cicerbita scoparia
intro: Cicerbita scoparia, commonly known as Blue Lettuce or False Dandelion, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family. The health benefits of Cicerbita scoparia include its ability to support digestive health, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural diuretic. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Cicerbita scoparia include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
